metric_definition: MSE and SSIM compare final RGB outputs after applying the same modification to clean and watermarked models. In the FT trials, the clean model retained its original weights and produced identical test images, so the effective reference is the original clean output. BER is 100 times the number of mismatched final-message bits divided by 256.
main_table_policy: Fixed evaluation_seed=0 for every row, 64 RGB pairs, consistent with table02; no per-row seed selection and no three-seed mean in display_row.
replicate_interpretation: Each evaluation restores the same selected watermark. Evaluation seeds 0, 1, and 2 use three distinct lists of 64 paired RGB generation inputs. For FT, the 64 training inputs and their fixed original-model targets are shared across evaluation seeds; the seed changes the order in which the examples are used.
source_policy: Only styleswin256_ffhq/lerra uses styleswin-range-extension-20261116 alpha=3.84. All other 29 generation model/method selections and their evaluations remain selected-robustness-20261113.
